name: Runemaster Glyph of Disappearance: Phase Out once more within 15 sec before its cooldown (#1229)
contract: Glyph of Disappearance 560037 (Riftblade, CharacterAdvancement 6475, level 40) reads 'Your Phase Out can now be
used 1 additional time within $561059d before incurring a cooldown.' Its only effect is aura 42 naming 561059,
but Spell.dbc gives it ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row exists, so the glyph never fired and Phase Out 500671
(RecoveryTime 120000, no charges) always went on its 2 min cooldown. 561059 is the window: effect 0 is
SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_RESET_COOLDOWN (195) on 500671, SpellDuration 8 = 15000 ms, tooltip 'You may use Phase
Out 1 additional time before it incurs its cooldown.' Expected: with the glyph, the first Phase Out leaves no
cooldown and opens the 15 sec window; a second Phase Out inside the window is accepted, closes the window and
incurs the normal 2 min cooldown; a window that ends unused incurs the cooldown the first use deferred, so
Phase Out becomes ready 2 min after that first use, exactly like the untalented Runemaster who cast at the same
moment. The window's effect 1 (aura 42 to 561058, a +90 sec cooldown helper) has no proc data and is not part of

steps.label: Let the characters settle
SETUP: the glyph is active
SETUP: the glyph is active on the second Runemaster
SETUP: Phase Out is cast
SETUP: Phase Out is cast by the second Runemaster
SETUP: Phase Out is cast without the glyph
Without the glyph Phase Out incurs its 2 min cooldown
With the glyph the first Phase Out incurs no cooldown
The glyph opens the 15 sec window
The window lasts 15 sec
The window is opened by the glyph
The second Runemaster's first Phase Out incurs no cooldown either
Phase Out is used an additional time inside the window
The additional Phase Out is accepted
The additional Phase Out incurs the 2 min cooldown
The additional use spends the window
The additional use opens no new window
The unused window ends after 15 sec
An unused window incurs the cooldown the first use deferred
Phase Out stays on cooldown after the unused window
